correctness.rationale: Trace restriction and Cayley–Hamilton reduce all rank-one idempotent decompositions to the explicit affine conic C_delta. Its reducible zero-determinant case has 2q-1 points; its nonzero-determinant smooth projective closure has q+1 points before deleting exactly the rational-eigenvalue points at infinity. Counting GL_2 conjugacy classes and squarefree/irreducible/repeated quadratic parameters gives both displayed global polynomials. Exhaustive tests over fields 2,3,4,5,7,8,9,11 verified all individual fibers and counts; the general proof does not extrapolate from tests.

originality.rationale: The earlier nil-clean-index lower bound (Basnet–Bhattacharyya, Proposition 4.4) does not yield the exact all-field upper bound or fiber distribution; the 2013 matrix-nil-clean classification studies existence for all matrices, not decomposition cardinalities. Checked related published results concern torsion-unit sums, multiplicative factorizations, weakly nil-clean indices, and strongly commuting decompositions, none of which implies this additive noncommuting fiber census. Exact earlier binary case and related finite special examples are acknowledged as prior. Residual risk remains from an inaccessible broader thesis and possible unindexed literature.

value.rationale: The prior published lower bound 2q-1 makes exact sharpness a natural motivated unresolved target; the theorem proves uniform equality for all prime powers, gives a complete labeled-matrix fiber distribution, and explains the discriminant strata by a geometric degeneration from smooth conics to a nodal pair of lines. The invariant is standard nil-clean index, not an arbitrarily selected slice. Earlier binary case and weak index variants are not claimed as novel.
